scripts.dev:infra:up: docker compose up -d postgres minio minio-init
scripts.dev:infra:prepare: pnpm dev:infra:up && pnpm db:wait && pnpm db:migrate
scripts.dev:stack: pnpm dev:infra:prepare && pnpm contracts:build && pnpm dev:stack:tui
scripts.dev:stack:prod: pnpm dev:infra:prepare && pnpm contracts:build && CHIBA3_NAMESPACE=prod CHIBA3_REGISTRY_ID=prod pnpm turbo run dev --ui=tui --filter @chiba-cable3/control-api --filter @chiba-cable3/control-mcp --filter @chiba-cable3/ops --filter @chiba-cable3/guide
scripts.dev:stack:with-node: pnpm dev:infra:prepare && pnpm contracts:build && pnpm turbo run dev --ui=tui --filter @chiba-cable3/control-api --filter @chiba-cable3/control-mcp --filter @chiba-cable3/ops --filter @chiba-cable3/guide --filter @chiba-cable3/node-runtime
scripts.db:wait: docker compose exec -T postgres sh -lc 'until pg_isready -U chiba -d chiba3 >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done'
scripts.db:reset: pnpm db:destroy && pnpm db:up && pnpm db:wait && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:import:registries
scripts.db:import:registries: pnpm db:import:registry -- --registry ./config/registry.local.toml --registry-id local && pnpm db:import:registry -- --registry ./config/registry.prod.toml --registry-id prod
